locucoes.text: The protagonist tenses up hearing a muffled moan coming from the next room, freezing as he tries to understand what bizarre sound that is.
Noh Yeseul is lying on the bed in an intense scene, tossing and turning as the sounds echo through the hallway.
But what... what is this?!
What am I hearing right now? My heart's racing, damn.
Wait, those sounds... aren't those moans? Man, things are heating up.
Oh, master, I can't believe this.
Is she really doing what I think she's doing?
Right now, that woman... in this kind of situation she decides to do this?
She surrenders completely to pleasure, closing her eyes and seeking relief amid the heat taking over the room.
The scene focuses on the movement of her hands, and the vibe is hotter than a desert, man.
Looks like she's really in that mood, my god.
Our protag feels himself falling into an abyss of confusion as darkness takes over his mind.
She's masturbating?! No way!
This is how today's chapter of The Inheritor begins, where things went totally out of control.
In the dim light, heavy breathing betrays the accumulated desire that finally overflows without any shame.
The pace quickens in the darkness and each physical stimulus provokes deep reactions, leaving her totally vulnerable.
The tension rises even more and the body responds to each touch with spasms that reveal pure surrender.
The impact hits her hard, stopping her breath and demanding total focus to handle the intensity of the moment.
Her hands grip the sheet as the wave of heat dominates and control goes away completely.
Her physical contact with herself is clear; the girl is losing it in the middle of the night.
The intensity increases and our boy stays there, frozen, hearing every detail of this moment.
Her flushed face gives away the level of exhaustion as she struggles to catch her breath after that peak.
Inhyuk watches her from afar, paralyzed, as the girl desperately tries to recover her breath.
He'll... he'll definitely leave me.
Why do you think that? Why are you saying these things?
It's that I don't have that kind of charm... you know, to make a man stay with me.
I'm probably acting like an idiot right now, but I can't stop looking.
I'll be abandoned by him... I know I will.
That's what I think, in the end.
Haha... don't worry about that, okay?
What do you mean? What are you saying?
Then she recalls when they mentioned that mysterious man was someone special.
That man is my son. I'm sure he'll definitely like you.
Her wide eyes reveal the shock of facing reality at the moment she least expected it.
Turns out that's not quite how it happened, right? After all, it wasn't the case.
Her gaze overflows with absolute ecstasy and she lets out a moan, totally surrendered to that overwhelming sensation.
The firm touch intensifies the wave of heat, making her sigh deeply as her body reacts without control.
The pressure increases and she moans softly, as each second tests the limit of her endurance.
That person... he can't see me like this, can he?
She's in a trance-like state, with a flushed face and completely irregular breathing.
Does he really see me as a woman?
A scream escapes without filter when reality crashes down and desperation takes over completely.
Noh Yeseul is badass, and look at the level this scene reached.
Even her feet contort with pleasure as Inhyuk hears everything from the other side.
Nnh... Ahhh... Right now, what should I do?
If I just do what I'm thinking...
Our protag stares at the floor with clenched fists, fighting against his own instincts.
If I open this door now...!
The atmosphere is so tense you can feel the heat coming through the crack in the door.
He swallows hard, sweat running down his face as doubt consumes the guy.
Then he puts his hand on the doorknob, trying to hold himself back somehow.
Through the crack, he can see inside the room and his heart almost jumps out of his mouth.
Inhyuk closes his eyes and starts imagining the scene inside; the protag's mind is fertile.
No, stop that. Let's calm down, Inhyuk.
It's the first time I've seen that woman like this, I didn't expect this.
That's why I can't do this. I need to return to reason right now.
Mr. Inhyuk... does that mean you have no desire?
Do you by any chance have no libido?
What?! How can you ask something like that?
I... I have desires, yes!
I... I'll show you what I'm capable of!
The environment becomes dark, the tension rises and he makes an impulsive decision.
Suddenly, he throws the door open, making a crack sound that echoes through the house.
TAKE THAT!
A SCARE!
Damn, she saw me! Now what?
He enters the room in a rush, without even thinking what he was going to say or do.
Inhyuk stands before her, his face redder than a chili pepper.
The scene before him is too detailed, with everything you can imagine from a moment like this.
M... Master? What are you doing here?!
Did you... hear me this whole time?
Forget that... just continue what you were doing.
Huh? What do you mean?! I told you to continue what you're doing right now.
I... I'm not kidding.
I'm talking about you masturbating. Continue, I want to see.
Noh Yeseul goes into shock, grabbing her collar not knowing where to hide her face.
Know that the sound was reaching outside, but he tells her not to worry about that now.
Then he says that, instead, he'd rather see her doing it right there in front of him.
You won't be able to sleep if you try to hold back like that, right?
So you can continue. You said you'd show me, so show me.
So... you really want to see?
Inhyuk watches her sitting on the bed, as the silence between them becomes almost deafening.
My god, I must have gone crazy. What the hell did I just say to her?
He hides his face in his hands, realizing the immense shame he just went through.
I told a woman I just met to let me watch her masturbate? I'm an idiot!
Outside, the full moon shines, oblivious to the mental chaos our protag is experiencing inside.
The kitchen is empty and cold, quite different from the vibe going on in that room.
Phew... sorry, I shouldn't have said that.
I think I lost my mind for a moment. I must be crazy...
Just go to sleep, Yeseul. Forget what I said.
Wait, what was that?! He just gave up?
The mood changes again, pink hearts appear in the air and desire returns with force.
The girl bites the bed fabric hard, trying to contain the scream that wants to come out.
Biting the sheet to muffle her voice, she tries to hold on to what's left of her composure.
The last sigh escapes loaded with gratitude and exhaustion, marking the end of this overwhelming sequence.
Thank you... Master! Thank you for this!
She stares into nothing as she bites her own clothes, determined to follow the order he gave.
Then she starts touching herself again in an even more intense way than before.
Her feet press the sheet so hard the fabric starts to crackle.
Thank you... thank you for giving me an order! I'll do exactly what you want!
Wait, is she really... she didn't stop?
Is she really doing this even with the door open?!
Poor Inhyuk, now he won't sleep anymore after that vision.
Inhyuk hesitates at the door, but Yeseul takes advantage of his submission to take total control of the situation.
